capabilities: Play A Dark Room in a native Obsidian view
Persist game progress in the plugin's data.json
Toggle compact mode for narrow views
Reset the game or export/import save codes
disambiguation: Not an image-editing or dark-theme tool; it is a port of the minimalist text adventure A Dark Room.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No audio is bundled, so the original's sound effects and music are missing. Detailed provenance, licensing (MPL-2.0 upstream, MIT adapter) and change lists live in external files (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, A-DARK-ROOM-MPL-2.0.md).
intentEvidence: Only the implementation method was changed without adjusting the game: The native view of Obsidian was used for re-construction
problem: There is no way to play the text adventure A Dark Room inside Obsidian without an embedded web page.
summary: Text-adventure game view that runs a port of A Dark Room as a native Obsidian view inside the vault.
